clauses.title: Scope – Requirements and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements and the methods of sampling and test for unbonded rock and slag wool for thermal insulation.

clauses.title: Types –
clauses.text: 2. Types -

clauses.title: Type 1 – Loose
clauses.text: 2.1  Type 1 - Loose rock and slag wool, shall be a fluffy, light weight material.

clauses.title: Type 2 – Stitched
clauses.text: 2.2  Type 2 - Stitched rock and slagwool mats. Shall be in the form of stitched mats  provided with a confining media   on  one or both sides. If the confining medium provided is of metallic cage,  it shall be attached to the mat either  stabbing at not more than 250 mm  centres of by stitching at not more  than 250 mm along the width and  150 mm along the length with twine or metallic wire of 0.7 mm or 0.56 mm diameter or as agreed. If the confining  medium  provided is of hessian cloth, scrim cloth, kraft paper or glass  tissue, it shall be stitched to the mat with a suitable twine.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 3. Requirements

clauses.title: Apparent Density
clauses.text: 3.1 Apparent Density —  The apparent density of Type 2 of the material shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. A tolerance of ± 15 percent shall be allowed on the manufacturer's declared value.

clauses.title: Apparent Density Under Specified
clauses.text: 3.2 Apparent Density Under Specified Load -  The apparent density under specified load of both types of the material shall be not more than the following values. Load Apparent Density Under Specified Kg/cm2 Load, Max At Factory At Site Kg/m3 Kg/m3 0.01 95 115 0.02 105 130 0.05 136 165 0.07 150 185 0.10 165 200

clauses.title: Shot Content – Shall
clauses.text: 3.3 Shot Content - Shall be not more than the values given below. Any shot present shall not be greater than 5 mm in any dimension. IS Sieve Shot Content, Percent by Mass, Max 500-micron 5 250-micron 10

clauses.title: Moisture Absorption – The
clauses.text: 3.4 Moisture Absorption - The material shall not gain in mass by more than 2 percent.

clauses.title: Incombustibility – The material
clauses.text: 3.5 Incombustibility - The material shall be rated as incombustible when it passes the prescribed test. The loss in total mass, when determined by this test, shall not exceed 5 percent.

clauses.title: Sulphur
clauses.text: 3.7 Sulphur  Content -  The material, after removal of the confining media, if any, shall not contain more than 0.6 percent of sulphur.

clauses.title: Width
clauses.text: 3.8 Width  - Type 2 material shall be supplied in width of 90 ± 5 cm or any other width mutually agreed upon between the buyer and the supplier.

clauses.title: Thickness – Type 2
clauses.text: 3.9 Thickness - Type 2 material shall be supplied in thickness of 25, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90 and 100 mm or as agreed upon  between the purchaser and the supplier. The usual tolerance allowed is - 5 mm.

clauses.title: Optional Requirements
clauses.text: 3.10  Optional Requirements

clauses.title: Moisture content – Shall
clauses.text: 3.10.1   Moisture content - Shall not contain more than 2 percent moisture.

clauses.title: Resistance to micro
clauses.text: 3.10.2 Resistance to micro-organisms - Shall not show any mould or bacterial growth.

clauses.title: Odour emission test –
clauses.text: 3.10.3 Odour emission test - There shall be no apparent difference in odour of the butter when compared with the blanks.

clauses.title: Oil content – Shall
clauses.text: 3.10.4  Oil content -  Shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier but it shall be not more than 2 percent.

clauses.title: Carbon content
clauses.text: 3.10.5 Carbon content — Shall not contain more than 0.3 percent of total carbon.

clauses.title: Resistance to vibration –
clauses.text: 3.10.6  Resistance to vibration -  Shall show not more than 1 percent by height of settlement.

clauses.title: Resistance to jolting –
clauses.text: 3.10.7 Resistance to jolting -  Shall show not more than 3 percent by height of settlement, or as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.

clauses.title: Heat resistance – Shall
clauses.text: 3.10.8 Heat resistance - Shall not suffer visible deterioration in the fibrous structure when heated to the maximum recommended temperature of use.

clauses.title: Fibre diameter – The
clauses.text: 3.10.9  Fibre diameter - The average fibre diameter of the wool shall not be more than 7 microns.

clauses.title: Alkalinty – The pH
clauses.text: 3.10.10 Alkalinty - The pH of the solution of the material shall be between 7.0 and 10.0.

clauses.title: Corrosive attack
clauses.text: 3.10.11 Corrosive attack —  Shall not cause corrosion of the surface on which it is applied. Note - It has been found that if the chloride content in the material exceeds 0.01 percent by mass and if the conditions are such that chloride concentration can take place on the surface of certain austenitic stainless steels, there is a possibility of stress corrosion at elevated temperature. If such an instance arises, suitable measures should be taken during the applications of insulation, for example, aluminium fail should be wrapped around the surface to be insulated before the application of insulation or an anticorrosive paint should be applied prior to the application of insulation.
